delivery.outcome: src/koru/poa/planning.py (511 lines, 4 classes, 15 functions) splits by responsibility into focused koru.poa submodules: errors.py (planning failure hierarchy), validation.py (shared primitive validators), snapshots.py (source-registry snapshot build/validate), policy_decisions.py (policy-boundary input hash and decision validation), plan_compile.py (inert plan compilation, binding selection, process-graph and result verification). planning.py remains a compatibility facade re-exporting the exact previous __all__ surface, so koru.poa.planning, koru.poa and koru.poa.logs imports are unchanged and the poa test suites pass unmodified. Pure code movement: identical messages, decision order and hashes.
nonGoals: Changing any validation rule, error message, decision order, schema or hash output
Removing or renaming any public name in koru.poa.planning.__all__

architecture.decision: Decompose the god module along its four responsibilities (failure hierarchy, primitive validation, source-registry snapshots, policy-boundary decisions, inert plan compilation) with a one-way dependency order errors -> validation -> snapshots -> policy_decisions -> plan_compile and no cycles; planning.py keeps only the compatibility facade re-exporting the previous __all__ so every existing import site is byte-compatible.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; the original single planning.py module is restored verbatim.
